# Ordered comparison results

Source: [Comparisons and truth](https://workshop.codes/wiki/articles/7978); page edited 2026-01-24. Evidence: source reported test; not independently game-verified.

Read [behavior and limitations](../articles/7978.md#wiki-7978) before using these values.

Rows are left operands; columns are right operands. Each category names a representative harness value, not every possible same-type value.

Five operators were measured: ==, >, <, >=, <=. There is no != measurement table.

Archived measurements: 2024-04-22, patch 2.10.0.0.124591; page edited later. C89J3 is the source-reported verification code. These results were not independently reproduced.
